text:
Blue hydrated copper(II) sulfate produces a white solid when it is heated.
The white solid turns blue when water is added.
Which word describes the reaction of hydrated copper(II) sulfate?
A
neutralisation
B
oxidation
C
reduction
D
reversible
subject: Chemistry
